classification.difficultyReason: Draw the taught two-stage binary tree and recognise that a head and a tail includes both HT and TH.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw a tree diagram showing all the outcomes.

answer.short: The tree has outcomes $HH, HT, TH, TT$.
answer.worked: Branch into $H$ and $T$ for the first coin, then into $H$ and $T$ again for each first-coin result. The four paths are $HH, HT, TH, TT$.

spec.description: Two-stage binary tree, with first-coin H above T and second-coin H above T.
spec.mathematics: Four ordered outcomes: HH, HT, TH, TT.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What is the probability that ‘a head and a tail’ are showing?

answer.worked:
The favourable outcomes are $HT$ and $TH$, out of four equally likely outcomes.
$$\begin{align*}P(\text{a head and a tail})&=\frac24\\P(\text{a head and a tail})&=\frac12\end{align*}$$
